notes: ACCESS: direct origin fetch with curl_cffi impersonate='chrome131' worked for the whole session (no proxy needed; r.jina.ai/WebFetch were reported 403 by the sibling Anthropologie worker and were not required). robots.txt (fetched 200) has no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot directive and no global Crawl-delay - only a Pinterest Crawl-delay:120 and Disallow on /wp-content/, *?webview=true, /*search?, /claims, /order-tracking, /order/, /password/reset, /wishlist/ - so no category path used here is disallowed. Fetches were spaced 9-20s. Datadome began returning 403 to every impersonation profile near the end of the run (a 5-profile sweep - safari18_0_ios, chrome124, firefox133, edge101, safari17_0 - all 403), which blocked a second-read drift check; all counts below were nevertheless double-sourced (see QTY). TREE: taken from the embedded nav JSON in script id=urbnInitialPiniaState -> catchAll.navItem, walking navigationItems from the 'home' node (Home + Dorm, 16 children). The Furniture department is a GATEWAY node (/furniture, no product listing of its own) with 8 children: Shop All Furniture and Ready To Ship Furniture (both dropped per brief section 3 - shop-all / marketing) plus the 6 real leaves recorded here. Every one of the 6 has childSlugs=[] and nestLevel 3, so this is the deepest level the site offers - no further subdivision exists. The categories sitemap (categories_sitemap.xml, 2098 URLs) was title-scanned for every furniture slug in the brief to confirm nothing was missed. QTY: primary source is the server-rendered listing header N products (brief rule 1). As an independent check each listing's server-rendered product tiles were enumerated from urbnInitialPiniaState category.pages[].wrapper.tiles by unique productId (paging via ?page=N where a page filled its 72-tile slot). Enumeration matched the header EXACTLY on 5 of 6 leaves (42/42, 81/81, 17/17, 23/23, 24/24); on Seating the header says 33 and 33 tiles render but only 32 productIds are distinct (one item is listed twice as two colourways) - the header value 33 is kept. Counts differ per category (33/42/81/17/23/24), none are round, and none equals the Home department total (1276 on /home), so no site-wide-constant or display-cap artefact. CONTENT CHECKS: every leaf's tile titles were read. 'Seating' (slug floor-pillows-cushions, site title 'Chairs + Seating') is filed under the Furniture department and is majority real furniture - sofas, sectionals, sleeper sofas, modular sofas, dining/desk/lounge/accent chairs, stools, benches, bean bag chairs, poufs - with a minority (~9 of 33) of floor pillows / daybed cushions / one sofa slipcover; kept whole as the site's own sofas-and-chairs node, since there is no separate sofa or chair listing. 'Storage Furniture' is genuine case goods (bookshelves, media consoles, storage cabinets, curio cabinets, dressers, vanities, kitchen islands, record racks), not bins. 'Accent Tables' is nightstands, side tables and coffee tables. EXCLUDED and why: /shop-all-furniture (185 products) and /small-space-furniture (98) - shop-all and a College+Dorm marketing curation (parentSlug on-campus under marketing-root); /ready-to-ship-furniture-web-ext and /furniture-sale (marketing/sale); /furniture-dorm-bookshelf-curation (curation); Storage + Organization > 'Storage Furniture' (slug storage-furniture, header 81 products) - same categoryId APARTMENT-FURNITURE-STORAGE and same 81-product population as /storage, i.e. the identical listing cross-linked under a second nav parent, so recorded once under the Furniture department; Storage + Organization > Wall Storage + Shelving (/shelving, 41) - tiles are wall shelves, wall hooks and hanging caddies, which the brief assigns to Wall Decor, not furniture; Bins + Baskets and Kitchen Storage (standalone storage goods); Bath > Bathroom Storage (/bathroom-shelving-storage, 4 products: a laundry bag, a tabletop locker, an over-the-toilet shelf and a ceramic jar - no vanity or bathroom cabinet, so no bathroom furniture node exists); Bedding, Home Decor, Kitchen + Dining, Lighting, Wall Art, Rugs, Bath, Stationery, Electronics and Sale branches (out of scope). ONE JUDGEMENT CALL: /tables ('Dining Tables + Desks', header 22 products, categoryId APARTMENT-FURNITURE-TABLES) exists in the categories sitemap but is NOT in the shopping nav - its navItem has parentSlug 'marketing-root' and ancestorSlugs ['marketing-root'], i.e. an SEO landing page, which brief section 3 excludes. Its population is 22 items of which 19 are already inside the recorded Desks + Vanities / Storage Furniture nodes; the only products it adds that appear in no nav furniture leaf are 3 dining tables (Carrie Round Mango Wood, Willow Wood Extendable Counter-Height, Nori Extendable Wood). Recorded as excluded rather than as a 7th row to avoid double-counting all 17 desks/vanities; consequence noted here: Urban Outfitters' 3 dining tables have no nav category of their own and are therefore not represented by any row. OVERLAP WARNING: the site's own Furniture siblings overlap - the union of the 6 leaves is 179 distinct products against a row sum of 220, because Storage Furniture (81) wholly contains Desks + Vanities (17) and Dressers (23). Rows are the site's own nav nodes with the site's own counts; they must not be summed.
